notes.title: Castle Crashers Painter Boss Paradise: Global and DLC Updates
notes.content:
[p]The Castle Crashers Painter Boss Paradise DLC is now available for Steam! Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/204360/view/543364553681930900"]official announcement and trailer here[/url], or read on to learn about all of the updates now in Castle Crashers![/p][p][/p][h2]Global Updates (Classic + Fresh)[/h2][p]The following updates are now present in the base game of Castle Crashers, in addition to the DLC version![/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Main Menu Art[/b][/p][p]8 new background vignettes based on lore from the Castle Crashers universe have been added to the main menu!

[b]2. Video Settings: Borderless Window Mode and Max Framerate
[/b]Windows users now have access to Borderless Window Mode in Video Settings. Windows and Mac users can now set a Maximum Framerate.[b]

3. Keyboard Settings[/b][/p][p]Magic macro binding options have been added for keyboard users.

[b]4. Gameplay: Z-axis Hitbox[/b][/p][p]The size of the Z-axis hitbox has been increased. Your attacks will have a better chance to be "lined up"!

[b]5. Gameplay: Health Potions[/b][/p][p]Main story solo play now has auto-heals enabled for Health Potions.

[b]6. Green Knight Update[/b][/p][p]Green Knight is no longer allergic to all forms of juggling. What about Allergic Green Knight, you may ask? That’s a story for another time.

[b]7. Art: Chainsaw Weapon[/b][/p][p]The Chainsaw Weapon now animates when held. WD-40!!!!

[b]8. Art: Back Off Barbarian[/b][/p][p]All Back Off Barbarian character art has been updated. (Except Hatty because Hatty is perfect.)

[b]9. UI and Menus[/b][/p][p]The Main Menu, Pause Menu, and Settings Menu buttons have been reorganized and updated.

[b]10. Reset Stats Confirmation[/b][/p][p]The Reset Stats menu now has a hold-down confirmation when resetting character stats.

[b]11. Attract Screen Update[/b][/p][p]The attract screen featuring the four base knights has been updated!

[b]12. Steam Input Support[/b]
Steam Input Support has been added, supporting more controllers and official actions when editing.

[b]13. Enhanced Rich Presence[/b]
Steam now displays player character, XP level, and bosses, in addition to area.

[b]14. Legacy Bug Fixes[/b]
Various bug fixes have been implemented to enhance your beat 'em up experience! To the community members who have sent in bug reports over the years - thank you so much from our (actually smoll) big chicken dev team![/p][p][/p][h2]Painter Boss Paradise DLC Updates[/h2][p]The following features are only present if you own the Painter Boss Paradise DLC.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Character: Paint Junior[/b][/p][p]A brand new official character has been added to the Castle Crashers roster, complete with a new weapon and fresh magic moveset that can also be used for Custom Character creation!

[b]2. Art: Playable Characters[/b][/p][p]All official playable characters in the classic Castle Crashers roster have new portraits and in-game art.

[b]3. Art: Equippable Weapons[/b][/p][p]All equippable weapons from the base game have updated art.

[b]4. Art: World Map[/b][/p][p]The world map has been completely redesigned for fancier adventuring!

[b]5. Painter Boss Toolkit[/b][/p][p]An entire DLC toolkit has been added to assist in Custom Character creation! To learn more about the toolkit and download the character template, please visit [url="https://beh.gg/PBP"]beh.gg/PBP[/url].

[b]6. Manager Menu[/b][/p][p]In the “Manager” menu, players can enable DLC characters and override existing playable characters with Custom Character skins.

[b]7. Weapon Skins[/b][/p][p]Custom Characters can toggle their weapon to be reskinned in the Weapons Frog via the Paint Brush. The weapon skin applied is always tied to the Custom Character’s art template. Only going to the Weapon Frog and choosing a different weapon or using the Paint Brush clears the Weapon Skin.

[b]8. Steam Workshop Capabilities[/b][/p][p]The Painter Boss DLC brings Steam Workshop capabilities to Castle Crashers for the first time ever! Publish your creations if you wish to share them with the world, or download and enable community creations!

[b]9. Behemoth DLC Character Collection[/b][/p][p]Enjoy an entire lineup of DLC characters created by our art team, in addition to some of the classic knight designs brought to the Steam Workshop! To get started with downloading DLC creations, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/id/thebehemothgames/myworkshopfiles/?appid=204360"][u]you can find all of our Workshop characters here[/u][/url]. Toggle them on and off at your whim! Make every enemy in the game Herbert! Save the princess as Ladderlad! Go on, now – Painter Boss Paradise awaits![/p]

notes.title: Painter Boss Paradise DLC Development Update
notes.content:
[h2]Happy New Year, knights![/h2]
Our team can’t thank you enough for the immense support, anticipation, and patience you’ve provided for this project, and we look forward to providing Steam Workshop integration to Castle Crashers for the first time EVER this year!!

Here’s a quick rundown of everything previously announced for the DLC:
[list]
[*] Steam workshop capabilities – create your own knight skins, choose your magic, and share with the world!
[*] New official character: play as Paint Junior, use your imagination, and create powerful art to vanquish your foes!
[*] New player and weapon artwork for all official playable characters (with an option to toggle on or off).
[/list]
Last month, we shared a DLC development update during our end-of-year stream, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=co2NnM0mnw0]which you can watch in its clipped form here[/url]! As announced in the video, our next DLC development update will take place next month!

[h2]Custom Characters[/h2]
There’s a lot of cool new menu art and screens we shared during the broadcast, but first, let’s get to the BEEF of this update – the custom characters! Need some inspiration? Look no further than these nine designs from our art team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/32be5d7822abe507ec731453f12e00ba160e2a5b.png[/img][i]Green Knight, are you okay???[/i]

When creating a custom character, there will also be sections on the template for a Back Off Barbarian piece, character portrait (shown in character select and level UI), and post-sandwich BEEFY form. You can get pretty creative with what your character can look like after eating a sandwich:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/3e6614dcafc9a5dbdaebdd43b70b314bebf9dc85.png[/img]
[i]Beefy time? More like GOALIE time![/i]

Since the template has multiple frames to animate your character's head in game, you can have some fun with their facial expressions while attacking or even at rest. Take our winking monkey, for example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/3c12fec4dbfc0189ff6ca6b9bb4c46d0ecea3552.gif[/img]

[h2]Main Menu Art and DLC UI Update[/h2]
Upon loading up the DLC after its release, you will be greeted with a new screen offering options for either OLD or FRESH art. Well, we aren’t here today to reminisce about the year you were born, so let’s choose FRESH.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/2d634e3f0faf92abfab4d8e69c6cbd2d09ef58f5.png[/img]
[b]“WAIT – WHAT IS THAT I SEE AFTER CHOOSING FRESH? NEW CASTLE CRASHERS MAIN MENU ART IN 2025?”[/b]

That’s right! There will be six new art scenes from iconic moments throughout the game, all rotating in the main menu. This new main menu art will be available for ALL OWNERS of the game, even if you don’t have the DLC! Here’s a quick sneak peek at one of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/942743e235506c5611f0a24aaf6a56bd251f1d7a.png[/img][i]Check out our recent YouTube livestream to see all six scenes![/i]

Next, we’ll head down to that freshly painted Painter Boss Paradise button and dive in! Here is another new screen that allows you to enable, create, or preload characters from the Workshop:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/7541e6e7384914b7717e2d7d5e44f0eb591ef4b9.png[/img]
Hitting the ENABLE button allows you to see all the characters you’ve created or imported from the Workshop. You’ll have to assign them to a character slot in the ENABLE menu in order to see them in the character select screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/bbf74a3d51293a0aeb7f2cc5e87321b07f241238.png[/img]
🗿

From there, you’ll be able to choose one of these powerful creations during character selection! If you’re interested in seeing Dan and Amanda run around the map with the new DLC characters, check out the stream recap below, and stay tuned for an even BEEFIER development update coming in February!

notes.title: Celebrating Valentine’s Day with Pink Knight! ❤️
notes.content:
Do you smell it?

[i]Sorry[/i], that’s not a very romantic way to start off a Valentine’s Day post. 

“HERE, I got this for you, SMELL IT!”

Better. But really…do you smell it? The happiness, the rainbows, the lollipops, roses and pure goodness? Is that a whiff of hamster shavings? And no, it’s not locker room body spray because our eyes aren’t burning. It’s VALENTINE’S DAY and even if your princess is in another castle, we have Pink Knight! We ALL have Pink Knight! Forever and ever, ten thousand years…PINK KNIGHT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/63babe91d9e1f55ade6e560c7985b1136c76ad94.png[/img]

In a world where the doom and gloom can become suffocating and bleak, a lone protector watches to make sure we don’t forget the true meaning of being alive: hamsters and weasels. In a world where hats become cursed and taxes don’t exist, Pink Knight is reminding us to put down our broccoli swords and instead sharpen your lollipop because it’s about to get real: we’re hosting a [b]Valentine’s Day Art Contest[/b] and the subject? [b]PINK KNIGHT OUR BELOVED.[/b]

[h2]What To Do and Not Do (Rules):[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Using your artsy fartsy skills, make a Valentine’s Day card featuring Pink Knight, in whatever art medium you like! Digital, paper, clay, decoupage, mosaic, marble sculpting, everything goes EXCEPT:
 Hair not allowed, just don’t, please don’t. No hair collages.
[*] We will be looking at this with our human seeing eyeballs, we’re fresh out of eye bleach, and we will be posting winning submissions so please keep it appropriate for general audiences. 
[*] When it is locked and loaded, neatly package your card and send it to our email: games@thebehemoth.com .
[*] Must be 18 years or older to participate, or have parental consent if under 18.
[/olist]

*If you would like to see your competition or share your design with other members of The Behemoth community, come on over to [url=https://discord.gg/thebehemoth]our Discord Server[/url] and share your post in our fan-art gallery! Be sure to post your artwork here on Steam, too!

Contest entries must be submitted no later than [b]11:59:59 PM PST on February 13th, 2024[/b]. If you’re even [i]one[/i] second off, we’re ripping the card into a million pieces and crying over an empty box of chocolates because you couldn’t care enough to submit on time. Would Hatty do that to you?!

Winners will be announced on Valentine’s Day, sometime! During the day. We’ll post our [b]three winners[/b] on our [url=https://blog.thebehemoth.com/2024/01/29/celebrating-valentines-day-with-an-art-contest/]blog[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/thebehemoth]social[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/thebehemothgames/]media[/url] once they have been Decided, and will notify the winners via the email they submitted their entry with.

YOU GET A PRIZE, YOU GET A PRIZE, YOU GET A PRIZE! And that’s it. Three winners. But what are they winning? 

[b]THIS JUST IN[/b] – an incredibly limited amount of Castle Crashers Pink Knight Figurines have appeared for this contest, this year, in 2024. We have been blessed with a very smol handful of the elusive Pink Knight figurines, and would like to spread the cheer this Valentine’s Day 🙂  Banana for scale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4101454/fa4c09066b2bb7794df461905a066b2fe8645915.png[/img]

This Pink Knight Figurine could be yours! [i]*Banana not included.[/i]

So what are you waiting for?

[i]Why are you still here reading this?[/i]

Why aren’t you out there making all the art with your art hands and art pens and pencils? You have a duty to Pink Knight, who never let you down, to capture their Really, Really Ridiculously Good Looking Side.

notes.title: 64-bit Castle Crashers Update
notes.content:
Earlier this month, Apple ended support for 32-bit Mac applications with the launch of macOS Catalina 10.15. This means that if you upgrade your macOS, you will be unable to use any 32-bit applications that you may have on your computer.

Today, we released a [b]64-bit update[/b] for Castle Crashers that will allow Mac users to continue playing the game on their newly upgraded operating systems. This is completely free to download; just update your game through the Steam client and you should be good to go.

If you run into any issues with the game after downloading the update, please be sure to submit a ticket to [url=support.thebehemoth.com]support.thebehemoth.com[/url] so we can look into it and provide assistance.

To learn more about the recent macOS update and how it may impact other applications, please see [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=1055-ISJM-8568]Steam’s FAQ here[/url].

Happy castle crashing!

notes.title: Jam Out with us and Celebrate Castle Crashers! 🎶
notes.content:
Tomorrow marks the 11th anniversary of Castle Crashers, which is no small day. We’ll be celebrating 11 years of Castle Crashers and the upcoming launch to Nintendo Switch and PS4 with the game’s music, and you’re invited to party with us!

Every week starting [b]tomorrow, August 27, 2019[/b] and running all the way through [b]October 8, 2019[/b], a musician will be covering one or more of the songs off the Castle Crashers soundtrack. You'll be able to catch these covers on YouTube, or watch them streamed live on Twitch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4101454/2872dcb46aef0d53649b49481e3a2db1e3ec36c5.png[/img]

We’ll be updating this blog with the new dates and times each week, so be sure to check back. For now, we’ll kick off the celebrations with the schedule for the first two musicians:

[h1]August 27th, 2019 at 1:30 PM PST - [url=https://www.twitch.tv/the8bitdrummer]The8BitDrummer LIVE on Twitch[/url][/h1]

The8BitDrummer is a drummer (big surprise there) who streams live covers to an exuberant audience on Twitch! We might be biased, but we're particularly impressed with his cover of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2kHxWJP15k8]BattleBlock Theater's Secret Stage music[/url] because he somehow managed to sing the entire thing.

He'll be starting off the celebration strong and playing through the ENTIRE Castle Crashers soundtrack, so you won't want to miss out on this madman's performance! 

[h1]September 3rd, 2019 at 2:00 PM PST - [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/FamilyJules7X/]FamilyJules Cover Premiere on YouTube[/url][/h1]

FamilyJules is a rad guitarist that is best known for his video game music covers — in fact, he's done well over 100! Of course, a part of that number is made up by Castle Crashers covers. If you're feeling a craving for rock and bones, we recommend checking out his original [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5dA25Cwa9XI]Necromancer Theme cover[/url].

He'll be premiering an all-new Castle Crashers cover that will have you smashing that replay button!


We have even more artists on the way to delight your eardrums and tug on your heartstrings by tugging on their instrument strings. Stay tuned (get it, tuned?) and check back here each week to see when the next show is!

notes.title: Pit People Out Now on Early Access!!
notes.content:
[img]http://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/BMTH-PP-PROMO3_STEAM_ONLY_FB_820x312.png[/img]

[Written by Dan]

THE TIME HAS COME! [url=www.pitpeople.com/game?utm_source=PPSteamHub&utm_campaign=PP_EA_Launch&utm_medium=textlin]Pit People[/url] is out on Steam Early Access! We can’t wait to get your feedback and we are glad to have you join us in our journey! 

Some of you have been with us since the beginning when it was [url=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/2014/08/20/first-look-at-game-4/] first known as Game 4 [/url], and many of you have already helped us out since our [url=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/2016/10/10/pit-people-beta-outcomes]Closed Betas in the fall of 2016[/url]. (If you beta tested and you’re curious what has been updated since 2016, check out [url=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/2017/01/09/pit-people-changelist-since-the-closed-betas/]this changelist[/url].) 

https://www.youtube.com/embed/y5MmzFM0DlE


[h1]If you own our other games, like Castle Crashers, you should receive items in Pit People for having them![/h1]

[img]https://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/BBT_CC_SpecialUnlocks.jpg[/img]

For you beautiful boppin’ Behemoth fans you’ll get the added bonus of cross-game unlocks in Pit People for owning our other games on the same Steam account. 
[url=https://support.thebehemoth.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000143086-How-do-I-get-the-cross-game-unlocks-in-Pit-People-on-Steam-]Click here to see how to unlock in Steam. [/url]

Pit People is now available on Steam! [b]Early pioneers of the game will receive permanent access to the full game for $14.99USD.[/b] When the game is in full release it will be $19.99USD -- but anyone who already owns the game would have their version automatically upgraded at no additional charge.

That’s right! If you dive in now you’ll get the game at a discounted price AND you can help us raise this thing like you’d raise a roof or a child.  I suppose neither one of those things being raised is completely accurate but I’m sure you understand.  We will be raising whatever this thing is together, indirectly and/or directly.  Yes sir or ma’am, you get 100% custody of your roof/child/videogame for only a fraction of the cost!  No custody battles today!!!!

Now I know you might find yourself wondering: “[i]But..Dan, what about Mariah Carey?[/i]” or “[i]I’m still not sure if that dress was gold or blue?[/i]” and to be perfectly honest, I don’t really know.  I have no idea what to tell you about those things. 

However, what I do know is that here at the Behemoth we’re all having a wonderful day.  We finally get to send our project out into the world feeling confident that it’s got more than enough nougat in there to satisfy you [i](Snickers Satisfies)[/i] until complete completion!  

Just hop onto Steam and grab it up!  

We look forward to getting your feedback during this Early Access period. Feel free to drop us a line on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/291860/discussions/]Pit People Steam Forums[/url], or [url=http://discord.gg/thebehemoth]our Discord[/url]. 

We hope you’ll also come join our [url=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/2017/01/05/pit-people-early-access-launch-week-extravaganza/]Pit People events next week[/url] as our level designers stream Pit People and I’ll be joining PC Gamer Show as a guest. See you then!

notes.title: Halloween Contest 2016
notes.content:
[img=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/halloween.jpg]
 
We’re hosting another [url=http://forums.thebehemoth.com/topic/18302-enter-our-2016-halloween-contest/]Halloween Contest[/url] this year (our 9th annual!!) and we’re looking forward to seeing what you come up with!
 
[img=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/810_5638375187339-S0961258.jpg]

 
To enter our contest just post a photo of your Behemoth related costumes or decorations in [url=http://forums.thebehemoth.com/topic/18302-enter-our-2016-halloween-contest/]this thread on our Behemoth forums[/url]. Behemoth related games include BattleBlock Theater, Castle Crashers, Alien Hominid, Alien Hominid PDA Games, Super Soviet Missile Mastar, or Dad ‘N Me. You could even do characters based on our current game in development, Pit People!
 
This thread will be locked on [b]November 2nd at 5PM PDT[/b], so be sure to get your entries in before we close the contest. We will review the entries and on November 4th we’ll select three winners for each category: (1) Costumes; (2) Decorations. That means we’re giving out 6 prize packages!
 
As always, judging will be based on creativity, originality, and hilarity or ability to inspire fear. Prize packages will include a Pit People Fighter tee and commemorative Behemoth pin (available only at PAX shows we exhibit at), plus your choice of Alien Hominid HD, Castle Crashers, or BattleBlock Theater game code (if you already own all three games, then you can give it to a friend!).
 

[img=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/pitpeopletshirt.jpg]



[h1]Rules: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Group entries are allowed! (Note: One prize per winning entry is awarded)
[*]Your entry must be your own creation (or your group’s, parent’s, family’s).
[*]Only new costumes and decoration entries will be accepted (entries that were submitted in previous years will not be eligible).
[*]Cosplay images are acceptable as long as they weren’t entered in a previous contest.
[*]Decorations can include pumpkin carvings, special treats, or other decorations in or outside of your abode.
[*]You may enter more than once.
[/list]


Need ideas?? Check out all the exemplary entries from the winners of our last Halloween contest [url=http://forums.thebehemoth.com/topic/17976-halloween-contest-2015-winners/]HERE[/url]!

notes.title: Extra Life 2014 - Play Games, Heal Kids
notes.content:
[img=http://blog.thebehemoth.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/extralifebanner.V2.jpg]
Hello World!
We’re on a not-so-secret mission to save kids and we need your help.

On October 24th, 2014, we’ll be participating in this huge worldwide celebration of the social impact of gamers of all kinds from video games to board games and tabletop RPG’s! This is our first time participating in Extra Life, and we’ve joined Raptr’s Team to support their efforts to fundraise for the Children’s Miracle Network (CMN). We’re one of many developers who will be streaming live between October 24th – 25th, 2014.


[h1]Our Fundraising Goals[/h1]
It’s our sincere hope that you’ll find it in your heart to support our efforts with a monthly pledge or one-time gift that will go directly to Rady Children’s Hospital through the CMN. We hope your donations will help us hit our goal of $1,000 raised from the community for this amazing organization. [b]In addition to your generous donation, we will match your donations![/b] Our goal is $1,000 from donors like you, but we will match up to $2,000 of the total contributions of all donors combined.

Your donation is tax-deductible and ALL PROCEEDS go to help kids. Click [url=https://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donate.participant&participantID=124938]HERE[/url] to donate now.


[h1]Our Raffle Prize[/h1]
On top of being an awesome person for supporting a great cause, if you donate $10 or more through our fundraising page you’ll get entered into our raffle for a new mystery plush. We’ll reveal the plush’s identity during our October 24th Extra Life stream on Raptr’s channel.

Make sure to click “Allow participant to see my email address” when you donate if you want to be entered into the raffle. If you do not want to be entered into the raffle, then you can donate anonymously.


[h1]Watch Our Live Stream[/h1]
October 24th, 2014 – 3PM to 4PM PST
[url=http://Twitch.tv/Raptr ]Twitch.tv/Raptr [/url]

We were invited by Raptr to be a part of their Extra Life marathon, so we’ll be streaming live from their Twitch TV channel on October 24th. Come watch us play our in-development game (tentatively titled [url=http://www.thebehemoth.com/game4]Game 4[/url])!

See what we’ve been working on for the past few months for Game 4 and chat with us during the live stream!

For the full game dev line up, see the Raptr Fundraising page here: www.extra-life.org/team/Raptr

You’ve got the details, so it’s all up to you now! Thank you for your support through your donations on our Extra Life fundraising page and for your moral support during our live stream on October 24th!

notes.title: Castle Crashers Steam Update 1.3
notes.content:
We’ve just launched our most updated version of Castle Crashers Steam edition. If you haven’t done so already, please download the update! Here are some of the things that have been improved:

[*] Added DirectInput controller support -- We currently supported only XInput controllers which is the newer way to support controllers. The older way is DirectInput, so now many older controllers should work.

[*] Added Keyboard or controller local coop support -- Users can now use a keyboard and a controller for two separate players in local co-op. Previously, both the keyboard and the first controller would be assigned to Player 1.

[*] Added launch parameters that can be set in the Steam Client prior to launch -- Added launch parameters to set the width, height, whether the application should be windowed or fullscreen, and whether we should disable audio.  These can be set in the Steam -> Castle Crashers -> properties -> Set Launch Parameters section.  The parameters are case insensitive, and we take the last value set (i.e. if you use "-width 3 -width 50", it will use 50.  Or, if you use "-fullscreen -window", it will use a full screen windowed mode).

[*] Character select issue when using keyboard controls resolved --  Resolved an issue with character select that would cause the keyboard  assignments to change.

[*] 'Medic' and 'Conscientious Objector' achievements no longer interfere with each other -- Prior to the update, if a user played the home castle though to barbarian war, and attempted to gain the medic achievement by resurrecting one other player in each level, then they would fail to get the 'Medic' achievement if they attack any enemies in those levels.  

[*] Added save default ini file -- If the user doesn't change their settings we still create an ini file with the default settings for the game.

[*] The game no longer runs faster than the desired gamespeed on slower machines -- Before the update, machines that ran at less than 30fps would attempt to 'catch up' missing game time when they ran above 30fps, resulting in game speed up.  We now account for this missing game time, so it does not build up and alter later game speed.

[*] Removed plug’n’play audio on Win 32 machines -- Removed the check for new audio devices on Win 32 machines. 

If you have any questions or experience any issues, please contact us by creating a ticket in our support system: [url=www.thebehemoth.com/support] www.thebehemoth.com/support[/url]

notes.title: Castle Crashers Steam Update 1.2
notes.content:
We’ve been working on another update for Castle Crashers Steam Edition! Now it is time for 1.2. Booya!

Each update goes through a meticulous process that requires every member of the Castle Crashers development team to give their input before the update is ready. Our team is working hard to optimize gameplay by addressing the various issues hindering optimal gameplay. We are researching solutions, updating menu and art design, programming all the changes into the game and, finally, testing it. When it is all done and final, we push a button somewhere up in the Internets and the update goes straight to your systems. 

Here’s what’s cram packed into Update 1.2: 

[] Resolved an issue that previously affected the game audio when the game is minimized to the task - Prior to this update, minimization did not pause the game audio. 

[] We now support mouse buttons to behave like keyboard keys. The user can use them in the keyboard settings!

[] Render optimization by redoing the letterbox rendering - The letterbox now renders a different way which hopefully will cut down on the number of pixels we draw.

[] New render option to turn letterbox on or off - Now in the game settings menu a player can select whether to have letterbox or stretch to fit.

[] New render option to toggle vsync - Vsync off on slow computers will make it render faster (It really makes a difference). Fast computers should leave it on for smoother rendering.

[] New render option to select texture quality - The options are “High” or “Standard.” This will adjust the minimum texture size. The “Standard” setting will cause some textures to appear less sharp. Default value is set to “High”. 

[] Steam overlay MAC buttons are now clickable. - We changed the way to do full screen that is more friendly with the Steam overlay.

[] No games found message updated - We added text to suggest creating a game if no online multiplayer games are found. There was some confusion by players why there were no online multiplayer matches available to join. However, we did not explain that there are no games to “join in progress.” So we added a few lines of text to help guide the player into creating a match of his or her own online. 
	
[] Gamepad analog stick and dpad will now allow the user to change their selection from All You Can Quaff (AYCQ) in the Online Multiplayer selection menu when they have selected AYCQ using mouseover. - Prior to this update the gamepad analog stick lost functionality in Online Multiplayer menu selection.

[] In the new update, we centered the window position when players change from fullscreen to windowed mode, so you should be able to move it anywhere on your screen. Previously, PC users may have noticed that changing from fullscreen to windowed mode on PC puts the window in the upper left of the screen, without a way to drag it back into frame.

[] Users can now Alt-tab out of PC full screen online multiplayer games during the loading screens without it halting progression. Prior to the update this Alt-tab during the loading screens would halt the progression until that user went back to the game or until they were dropped. 

[] Lobbies are only listed once and duplicates should now be non-existent. - Duplicate lobbies were listed in the past. If friends joined the same lobby then any other friend who searched for lobbies would get that lobby listed for every friend in the lobby. 
	
[] In window mode some resolutions had been skewing mousing coordinates on Windows machines. Some resolutions we set were overridden by the OS. Now everything is fixed!

There’s a lot involved with the planning of these new changes as you can imagine. We have started looking into what we can improve in the game for update 1.3, but it may take us a bit longer since those issues require much more research to find solutions and testing on various systems to emulate the different specs you may have versus your fellow Castle Crashers buddy’s system. Thanks again for your understanding and patience!

notes.title: Castle Crashers Steam Update 1.1
notes.content: Today, the first update for Castle Crashers Steam Edition will go live. We have made a few adjustments to the game to increase performance and added a few new visuals tailored for Steam gameplay. Here are some of the changes that are in the first update: [] We’ve improved performance by correcting a memory leak that appeared to affect certain systems. We found that this was related to how specific computers handled audio, which is why this affected only some players and not all. If this had been affecting you prior to the update and it still affects you after downloading the first update please let us know by going to our support page and filling out a support ticket. [] We’ve improved overall performance by adding Push-to-Talk support as part of a new Audio Settings menu. This lets the player Enable/Disable Voice Chat, Enable/Disable Push-to-Talk, and set the keyboard key used for Push-to-Talk. If you have Push-to-Talk enabled, the default PTT key is “T” or pressing L3 on the primary local controller. [] In order to get to the game quicker, we’ve added the ability for players to move through the logo and legal screens quicker when the game boots up using either the escape key, the enter key, the space key or 'A' button on a controller. [] To celebrate the Steam edition, Dan has drawn some new artwork for the main menu (Woot!). [] Checking leaderboards in the game demo will no longer cause the pause menu to break. [] We’ve reverted to the default keyboard controls that were originally used to design the game back in the Stone Age when Ye Olde Side-Scroller was but a glimmer of a dream: A - Quick Slash S - Jump D - Special Item (ie bow and arrow) W - Fierce Slash E - Magic Mode Q - Shield C - Toggle Special Item (could do both Z and C for that) The new keybindings will not affect anyone who purchased and played the game prior to the release of the update. Your keyboard settings are safe! If you don’t see an issue that was affecting you on this list, don’t worry! Some other issues brought to our attention by the community take longer to identify, fix, test and verify than those listed in the first update. Our second update is hot on the heels of this one, so it won’t be long before we have more performance enhancements (Go Lance!) and other improvements! P.S.
